hypothesised_pattern: The target has a missing even (U-shaped) dependence on x4, rising with |x4|, so the base model under-predicts for large |x4| and over-predicts for |x4| below about 0.7.
rationale: Positive residuals occur at x4 = +0.92, +1.34, -1.82, -1.76, -1.28, while negative residuals occur at x4 = -0.66, +0.27, +0.55, +0.15, +0.37. The separation is by |x4| rather than by the sign of x4, which is the signature of an unmodelled quadratic-type term.
